say:3:1041302001:1.text: Yeah, I really miss when I was in school. My biggest worry was my lessons, not like now...
say:3:1041302001:1.source_cn: 说起来，我还真怀念我上学的时候，最大的烦恼只是怎么学好...

say:4:1041302002:1.text: By the way, what was Lyca like when she was in school?
say:4:1041302002:1.source_cn: 对了，我还没入学的时候，莱卡是怎么样的？

say:5:1041302003:1.text: Ha! So now you want to know about your sister. Well, when she was in school, she was very different compared to now.
say:5:1041302003:1.source_cn: 开始关心姐姐了啊~她上学的时候啊，哈哈，和现在很不一样...

choice_prompt:6:1041302003.text: Ha! So now you want to know about your sister. Well, when she was in school, she was very different compared to now.
choice_prompt:6:1041302003.source_cn: 开始关心姐姐了啊~她上学的时候啊，哈哈，和现在很不一样，非常有意思。

say:7:1041302004:1.text: When Lyca was a student, she was so cute and a little clingy, to be honest. She was always following me along.
say:7:1041302004:1.source_cn: 刚入学的莱卡呀……那时候又可爱又黏人，总喜欢跟在我后面...

say:8:1041302005:1.text: You don't know, but the Lyca that you see now, who is so brave and strong, would cry so easily when she was having a tough time at school.
say:8:1041302005:1.source_cn: 你们还不知道吧，咱们现在坚强勇敢又可靠的莱卡，上学的时...

say:9:1041302006:1.text: Whether it was losing to Eironn and Parisa in a test or missing a target in an archery competition, she always came to me when she cried because she didn't want the others to see.
say:9:1041302006:1.source_cn: 她哭的时候总会来找我，不想让别人看到。不管是考试输给埃...

say:10:1041302007:1.text: Really?! No way! I have to go find her and ask her about this!
say:10:1041302007:1.source_cn: 什么？！哈哈哈……不行，我得去找她好好“回忆”一下过往！

say:11:1041302008:1.text: Florabelle! Stop talking about the past!
say:11:1041302008:1.source_cn: ——芙拉贝尔！快停下，别继续说啦！

say:12:1041302009:1.text: Lyca, aren't you being a little rude? I am the person who has always supported you through all your tears.
say:12:1041302009:1.source_cn: 莱卡，怎么对学姐这么凶啊？唉，当初是谁帮你擦的眼泪……

say:14:1041302011:1.text: Tell me more about your school days, Lyca!
say:14:1041302011:1.source_cn: 莱卡，再给我讲讲你上学时候的事情呗！

say:15:1041302012:1.text: Hey! Don't go! It's just starting to get interesting!

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 你说得我都有点好奇了
